fusions.name: Batter and Run
fusions.desc: Bolts you up to 6 tiles to the target and deals 13 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Breakneck Finish
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 25% health from up to 6 tiles, dealing 20 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach, and leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolt Clear
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands. You move 30% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Sprinting Guard
fusions.desc: When you have covered enough ground, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
